label: Неожиданно
description: A 10-sentence usage card for неожиданно (unexpectedly, suddenly).

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Manner of action. 'Неожиданно' modifies 'пришёл', telling us his arrival came as a surprise. Placed before the verb, it sets up an unforeseen turn of events.
Strategic focus: Sentence-initial surprise. 'Неожиданно' opens the sentence to stress that the rain came without warning. Fronting the adverb dramatizes the abruptness of the event.
Strategic focus: Stacked adverbs. 'Неожиданно' modifies the whole act of laughing while 'громко' adds volume. Together they paint a sudden, loud burst that caught everyone off guard.
Strategic focus: Unforeseen event. 'Неожиданно' modifies 'зазвонил', marking the call as startling. The time word 'ночью' deepens the sense of an unwelcome surprise.
Strategic focus: Sudden appearance. 'Неожиданно' modifies 'появился', showing the guest turned up out of the blue. The adverb is a natural partner for verbs of appearing.
Strategic focus: Chance encounter. 'Неожиданно' modifies 'встретили', framing the meeting as a happy coincidence. It conveys that nobody planned this run-in.
Strategic focus: Abrupt change. 'Неожиданно' modifies 'изменилась', stressing how fast the weather turned. The adverb pairs well with verbs of sudden transformation.
Strategic focus: Surprise to others. 'Неожиданно для всех' shows the departure shocked everyone, with 'для всех' naming who was caught off guard. A common idiomatic extension of the adverb.

missions.phrase: Свет неожиданно погас во всём доме.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Sudden interruption. 'Неожиданно' modifies 'погас', marking the blackout as instant and unplanned. The adverb heightens the drama of the moment.

Strategic focus: Modifying a quality. Here 'неожиданно' modifies the adjective 'простым', meaning the answer was surprisingly simple. The adverb intensifies an unexpected degree rather than an action.
